text: The original meta-analysis reported a statistically significant reduction in MACE with RR 0.63 (95% CI 0.53 to 0.75). After excluding the retracted and replaced PREDIMED trial under default policy, the recalculated effect was RR 0.43 (95% CI 0.32 to 0.58), which remains statistically significant but shows a larger effect size. Two studies remained in the analysis: de Lorgeril 1994 with no notices and Singh 2002 with an expression of concern. The verdict is ESTIMATE_SHIFTED and the interpretation is NEEDS_QUALIFICATION. An independent cross-check confirmed the recalculated RR 0.43 (95% CI 0.32 to 0.58) and agreed with the finding.
